items.source: If this annotation is applied to a sliced test, a no-op Tracer and an ObservationRegistry are added to the application context.
items.translation: 如果将此注解应用于切片测试，则会在应用程序上下文中添加一个空操作 `Tracer` 和一个 `ObservationRegistry`。

items.source: Whether traces should be reported to external systems in the test.
items.translation: 测试中是否应将跟踪信息报告到外部系统。
